
# Status 86

Status of the virtual cash

* ISSUED - Virtual cash increase is created.
* CONFIRMED - Virtual cash increase was successfully processed.
* CANCELLED - Virtual cash increase was cancelled.

`Status86`

| `Confirmed` |
